title: Wall Mounted Soap Dish, 4.5-Inch Solid Brass | Autumn Sparkle | Brass Soap Dishes | Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep bar soap off the countertop and maintain a clean sink area with a wall mounted soap dish designed for everyday bathroom use in Autumn Sparkle, which captures the rich, warm tones of fall foliage with subtle shimmer, bringing seasonal warmth year-round.

  • Autumn Sparkle transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Coordinate your space: Part of the Brass Soap Dishes collection for a cohesive accessory look.
  • Fits transitional style: A distinctive design that pairs well with transitional bathroom hardware and other versatile bath accessories.

Dimensions (L x H x W): 4.5 x 3 x 3.5 in.
